official_rule_context.title: 上海国际能源交易中心交割细则
official_rule_context.publisher: 上海期货交易所网站 / 上海国际能源交易中心
official_rule_context.section: 第十五章 第二百一十六条
official_rule_context.paraphrase: 集运指数（欧线）期货以现金方式交割。
official_rule_context.scope: Contract settlement mechanism only; not Wind field definition or returned-series source.

limitations: Six returned dates only; neither earliest available warehouse history nor full historical coverage is certified.
Continuous and selected month-contract values agree only in the checked cells; this does not certify universal contract aggregation semantics.
Raw zero values are retained; an all-zero sequence is not treated as missing or proof of current activity.
Raw nulls are retained; four missing samples do not prove missing entitlements or absence of all related fundamentals.
Warehouse units and upstream source are not reported by these Wind responses; products must not be summed across unknown units.
Product cohort uses the saved August CFA and September Wind reconciliation, not a fresh October census.
Official cash-delivery context for EC is separate from Wind metadata and does not prove the technical reason for a null response.
Remaining quota and billable units are unknown; the cell estimate is a local planning estimate.
